curtain.Size=UDim2.fromScale(1,1);curtain.Active=true;curtain.Modal=true;curtain.Parent=blocker

panel.Position=UDim2.fromScale(.5,.5);panel.Size=UDim2.fromOffset(510,238);panel.Parent=curtain;Theme.panel(panel)
local title=text(panel,"Heading","ĐANG TẢI HỒ SƠ",UDim2.fromOffset(24,22),UDim2.new(1,-48,0,34),21)

local detail=text(panel,"Detail","Đang khôi phục trang bị và tiến trình của bạn…",UDim2.fromOffset(26,67),UDim2.new(1,-52,0,92),15)

 return false

local function refresh()

 local state=player:GetAttribute("ProfileSaveState") or "Loading"
 local notice=player:GetAttribute("ProfileStatusText")
 blocker.Enabled=not ready or state=="Conflict"
 local failed=failures[state]==true
 title.Text=if failed then "CHƯA TẢI ĐƯỢC HỒ SƠ" else "ĐANG TẢI HỒ SƠ"
 detail.Text=if type(notice)=="string" and notice~="" then notice elseif failed then "Tiến trình chưa tải được. Thử tải lại để tiếp tục với dữ liệu đã có." else "Đang khôi phục trang bị, vật phẩm và tiến trình của bạn…"
 retry.Visible=failed;retry.Active=failed and os.clock()>=nextRetryAt
 retry.Text=if os.clock()<nextRetryAt then "ĐANG THỬ LẠI…" else "THỬ TẢI LẠI"
 retry.TextTransparency=if retry.Active then 0 else .5
 local camera=workspace.CurrentCamera
 if camera then
  local size=camera.ViewportSize
  scale.Scale=math.min(1,math.max(.25,(size.X-32)/510),math.max(.25,(size.Y-40)/238))
 end
end
connect(retry.Activated,function()
 if not retry.Active then return end
 if request("RetryLoad") then nextRetryAt=os.clock()+5 end
 refresh()
end)
for _,name in {"ProfileReady","ProfileSaveState","ProfileStatusText"} do connect(player:GetAttributeChangedSignal(name),refresh) end
local elapsed=0
connect(RunService.Heartbeat,function(dt)
 if not blocker.Enabled then return end
 elapsed+=dt;if elapsed>=.25 then elapsed=0;refresh() end
end)
script.Destroying:Connect(function()
 for _,connection in connections do connection:Disconnect() end
 blocker:Destroy()
end)
refresh()

-- P1-E merchant, crafting station and harvesting UI. The shared equipment
-- inventory displays all carried items; receipts and harvests belong to the server.
local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")
local Input = game:GetService("UserInputService")
local GuiService = game:GetService("GuiService")
local RunService = game:GetService("RunService")
local Theme = require(ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild("Shared"):WaitForChild("UITheme"))
local C = Theme.Colors

local playerGui = player:WaitForChild("PlayerGui")

local connections = {}

local context, removingCharacter, ownedHold

local snapshot = {Coins = 0, Materials = {}, Stored = {}, HammerLevel = 1, Revision = -1}
local INK, CREAM, MUTED, GREEN, AMBER = C.Panel, C.Text, C.Muted, C.Health, C.Gold

local function connect(signal, callback)
	local connection = signal:Connect(callback)
	table.insert(connections, connection)
	return connection
end
local function finite(value)
	return type(value) == "number" and value == value and math.abs(value) < math.huge
end
local function count(value, fallback)
	return if finite(value) then math.max(0, math.floor(value)) else (fallback or 0)
end
local function numberAttribute(name, fallback)
	local value = player:GetAttribute(name)
	return if finite(value) then value else fallback
end
local function rounded(item, radius)
	Theme.round(item, radius or 8)
end
local function frame(name, parent, size, position, anchor)
	local item = Instance.new("Frame")
	item.Name = name; item.Size = size; item.Position = position
	item.AnchorPoint = anchor or Vector2.zero
	item.BackgroundColor3 = INK; item.BackgroundTransparency = .04
	item.BorderSizePixel = 0; item.ZIndex = parent:IsA("GuiObject") and parent.ZIndex + 1 or 2
	item.Parent = parent; Theme.panel(item)
	return item
end
local function label(name, parent, text, position, size, textSize)
	local item = Instance.new("TextLabel")
	item.Name = name; item.Position = position; item.Size = size
	item.BackgroundTransparency = 1; item.Font = Enum.Font.GothamMedium
	item.TextColor3 = CREAM; item.Text = text; item.TextSize = textSize or 13
	item.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left; item.TextYAlignment = Enum.TextYAlignment.Center
	item.TextWrapped = true; item.ZIndex = parent:IsA("GuiObject") and parent.ZIndex + 1 or 2
	item.Parent = parent
	return item
end
local function button(name, parent, text, position, size)
	local item = Instance.new("TextButton")
	item.Name = name; item.Position = position; item.Size = size
	item.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(60, 112, 76); item.BorderSizePixel = 0
	item.TextColor3 = CREAM; item.Font = Enum.Font.GothamMedium; item.TextSize = 13
	item.Text = text; item.TextWrapped = true
	item.ZIndex = parent:IsA("GuiObject") and parent.ZIndex + 1 or 2
	item.Parent = parent; Theme.button(item)
	return item
end
local function enabled(item, value)
	item.Active = value; item.Selectable = value; item.AutoButtonColor = false
	item.BackgroundColor3 = C.Card; item.BackgroundTransparency = if value then 0 else .4
	item.TextColor3 = if value then CREAM else MUTED
end

end
local function canCarve()
	local hum = characterParts()
	return alive and hum ~= nil and hum.Health > 0 and player:GetAttribute("InHunting") == true
		and player:GetAttribute("QuestState") == "Harvest" and player:GetAttribute("QuestResult") == "Defeated"
		and player:GetAttribute("AdminFlying") ~= true and player:GetAttribute("Drawn") ~= true
		and not panel.Visible and not otherMenuOpen()
end
local function startCarve(owner)
	if ownedHold or not canCarve() or currentAction() or player:GetAttribute("HuntCarveAvailable") ~= true then return end
	ownedHold = {Owner = owner, Observed = false, RunId = player:GetAttribute("QuestRunId")}

end
local function availableToken()
	local token = snapshot.OperationToken
	return type(token) == "string" and token ~= "" and token or nil
end
local function requestMutation(action)
	local now = workspace:GetServerTimeNow()
	local hum = characterParts()
	local token = availableToken()
	if not panel.Visible or not token or now < nextMutationAt or not hum or hum.Health <= 0
		or player:GetAttribute("AdminFlying") == true or otherMenuOpen() then return end
	if pendingToken == token and pendingUntil and now < pendingUntil then return end
	if (action == "MerchantBuyTrap" or action == "MerchantBuyPotion") and context ~= "Merchant" then return end
	if (action == "CraftIronTrap" or action == "UpgradeHammer") and context ~= "Craft" then return end
	nextMutationAt = now + .35; pendingToken = token; pendingUntil = now + 2
	notice.Text = "Đang xử lý..."
	remote:FireServer(action, token) -- A receipt token is issued/rotated only by the server.
end
local function updatePanel()

	for _, row in rows do
		local stock = snapshot[row[3]]
		stockLabels[row[1]].Text = string.format("%s · %d", row[2], count(type(stock) == "table" and stock[row[1]]))
	end
	local merchant, crafting = context == "Merchant", context == "Craft"
	heading.Text = if merchant then "THƯƠNG NHÂN · KHO TÀI KHOẢN" elseif crafting then "CHẾ TẠO · KHO TÀI KHOẢN" else "KHO TÀI KHOẢN"
 saveStatus.Text=player:GetAttribute("ProfileStatusText") or "Đang tải tiến trình…"
 if player:GetAttribute("ProfileStorageMode")=="TestMemory" then saveStatus.Text="DỮ LIỆU TEST · không lưu qua Stop/Play" end
	activityTitle.Text = if merchant then "VẬT TƯ THƯƠNG NHÂN" elseif crafting then "BÀN CHẾ TẠO TẠI CĂN CỨ" else "VẬT TƯ LƯỢT SĂN"
	description.Text = if merchant then "Bẫy thô cần ghép với sắt tại căn cứ để thành bẫy sắt. Vật tư đã mua ở lại kho cho lượt sau."
		elseif crafting then "Chế từng bẫy sắt hoặc nâng búa một lần. Công thức dùng nguyên liệu đang có trong kho."

	buyTrap.Visible = merchant; buyPotion.Visible = merchant; craftTrap.Visible = crafting; upgrade.Visible = crafting
	activeItems.Visible = not merchant and not crafting
	local run = snapshot.ActiveRun
	activeItems.Text = if type(run) == "table" and type(run.Id) == "string" then string.format("ĐANG MANG TRONG LƯỢT SĂN\nBẫy sắt · %d\nThuốc ngủ · %d", count(run.IronTraps), count(run.Potions)) else "Chưa có lượt săn đang diễn ra.\n\nNhặt sắt trong khu săn để chế bẫy và nâng búa."
	local now = workspace:GetServerTimeNow()
	local ready = player:GetAttribute("ProfileReady")==true and player:GetAttribute("ProfileSaveState")~="Error"

	local materials = if type(snapshot.Materials) == "table" then snapshot.Materials else {}
	local stored = if type(snapshot.Stored) == "table" then snapshot.Stored else {}
	recipeStatus.Visible = crafting

	recipeStatus.TextColor3 = if count(stored.RawTrap)>=1 and count(materials.Iron)>=1 then GREEN else C.Warning

local function applySnapshot(dto)
	if type(dto) ~= "table" then return end
	local revision = if finite(dto.Revision) then dto.Revision else snapshot.Revision
	if revision < snapshot.Revision then return end
	local previousToken = snapshot.OperationToken
	for _, key in {"Coins", "Materials", "Stored", "HammerLevel", "ActiveRun", "OperationToken"} do
		snapshot[key] = dto[key]
	end
	snapshot.Revision = revision
	if snapshot.OperationToken ~= previousToken then pendingToken = nil; pendingUntil = nil end
	if type(dto.Notice) == "string" then showNotice(dto.Notice) end
	updatePanel()
end
local function refresh()

		or otherMenuOpen() or ((context == "Merchant" or context == "Craft") and inHunting)) then hidePanel() end

		if currentAction() then ownedHold.Observed = true end

		elseif ownedHold.Observed and not currentAction() then ownedHold = nil end
	end

	local camera = workspace.CurrentCamera

		local size = gui.AbsoluteSize
		panelScale.Scale = math.min(1, math.max(.45, (size.X - 32) / 580), math.max(.45, (size.Y - 48) / 460))
		local scale = math.min(1, (size.X - 32) / 420, (size.Y - 48) / 460)
		harvestScale.Scale = scale
		local compact=size.X<1000 or size.Y<560
		harvest.AnchorPoint = if compact then Vector2.new(.5,1) else Vector2.new(1,1)
		harvest.Position = if compact then UDim2.new(.5,0,1,-12) else UDim2.new(1,-20,1,-24)
	end
	harvest.Visible = live and inHunting and state == "Harvest" and player:GetAttribute("QuestResult") == "Defeated"
		and not flying and not panel.Visible and not otherMenuOpen()

	local completed = math.clamp(count(player:GetAttribute("HuntCarves")), 0, 3)
	carved.Text = string.format("Đã mổ %d / 3", completed)
	local action = currentAction()
	local left = math.max(0, numberAttribute("HuntHarvestEnds", now) - now)
	local duration = math.max(.01, numberAttribute("HuntHarvestDuration", 1.5))
	carveButton.Text = if action then string.format("GIỮ G · ĐANG MỔ %.1fs", left)
		elseif completed >= 3 then "ĐÃ MỔ ĐỦ 3 LƯỢT" else "GIỮ G · MỔ XÁC (1,5s)"
	enabled(carveButton, canCarve() and completed < 3 and (action or player:GetAttribute("HuntCarveAvailable") == true))

	harvestHint.Text = if completed >= 3 then "Đã nhận đủ nguyên liệu mổ. Có thể tiếp tục nhặt đồ hoặc về sảnh."
		elseif player:GetAttribute("Drawn") == true then "Nhấn R cất vũ khí trước khi mổ xác."
		elseif action then "Giữ G/nút · đứng yên; thả để hủy."
		elseif player:GetAttribute("HuntCarveAvailable") == true then "Giữ G 1,5 giây để nhận một phần nguyên liệu."
		else "Đến gần xác và cất vũ khí để mổ."
end

local function orbit(v,yaw,pitch)
	local center=v:GetAttribute("OrbitCenter");local distance=v:GetAttribute("OrbitDistance")
	if not center or not distance then return end
	local angle,elevation=math.rad(yaw),math.rad(pitch)
	local direction=Vector3.new(math.sin(angle)*math.cos(elevation),math.sin(elevation),-math.cos(angle)*math.cos(elevation))
	local boundsSize,boundsCF=v:GetAttribute("OrbitBoundsSize"),v:GetAttribute("OrbitBoundsCFrame")
	if boundsSize and boundsCF then
		local orientation=CFrame.lookAt(center+direction,center).Rotation
		local pixels=v.AbsoluteSize
		local aspect=if pixels.X>0 and pixels.Y>0 then pixels.X/pixels.Y else v.Size.X.Offset/math.max(v.Size.Y.Offset,1)
		local tanV=math.tan(math.rad(v.CurrentCamera.FieldOfView*.5))
		local tanH=tanV*math.max(aspect,.1)
		local half=boundsSize*.5
		distance=1
		for _,x in {-1,1} do for _,y in {-1,1} do for _,z in {-1,1} do
			local corner=boundsCF:VectorToWorldSpace(Vector3.new(half.X*x,half.Y*y,half.Z*z))
			local q=orientation:VectorToObjectSpace(corner)
			distance=math.max(distance,q.Z+math.abs(q.X)/tanH,q.Z+math.abs(q.Y)/tanV)
		end end end
		distance*=1.15
	end
	v.CurrentCamera.CFrame=CFrame.lookAt(center+direction*distance,center)
end

	model.Parent=v.PreviewWorld

	orbit(v,yaw or 18,pitch or 5)

local function cleanClone(source)
	local archivable=source.Archivable;source.Archivable=true
	local clone=source:Clone();source.Archivable=archivable
	if not clone then return nil end
	for _,v in clone:GetDescendants() do
		if v:IsA("LuaSourceContainer") or v:IsA("JointInstance") or v:IsA("Animator") then v:Destroy()
		elseif v:IsA("BasePart") then v.Anchored=true
		elseif v:IsA("Trail") or v:IsA("ParticleEmitter") then v:Destroy() end
	end
	for _,name in {"EquipmentArmor","TrainingArmor","TrainingWeapon","WeaponR","WeaponL"} do
		local old=clone:FindFirstChild(name);if old then old:Destroy() end
	end
	clone:PivotTo(CFrame.new())
	return clone
end
local function addWeapon(actor,target,id)
	local model=Builder.build(id);model.Name="PreviewWeapon"
	local root=actor.PrimaryPart or actor:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart") or actor:FindFirstChild("Root")
	if not root then model:Destroy();return end
	local sizes={Hammer=.7,SwordShield=.8,Katana=.75,Glaive=.55,DualDaggers=.9,Bow=.7,GreatAxe=.7}
	for _,assembly in model:GetChildren() do
		local left=assembly.Name=="Offhand" or id=="Bow"
		local bone=if target=="Pet" then actor:FindFirstChild(if left then "GripL" else "GripR")
			else actor:FindFirstChild(if left then "LeftHand" else "RightHand") or actor:FindFirstChild(if left then "Left Arm" else "Right Arm")
		if bone then
			assembly:ScaleTo(if target=="Pet" then sizes[id] else .9)
			local position=bone.Position+(if target=="Pet" then Vector3.zero else Vector3.new(0,-bone.Size.Y*.35,0))
			assembly:PivotTo(CFrame.new(position)*root.CFrame.Rotation*CFrame.Angles(-.25,if id=="Bow" then math.pi/2 else 0,0))
		end
	end
	model.Parent=actor
end

local function orbit(v,yaw,pitch)
	local center=v:GetAttribute("OrbitCenter");local distance=v:GetAttribute("OrbitDistance")
	if not center or not distance then return end
	local angle,elevation=math.rad(yaw),math.rad(pitch)
	local direction=Vector3.new(math.sin(angle)*math.cos(elevation),math.sin(elevation),-math.cos(angle)*math.cos(elevation))
	local boundsSize,boundsCF=v:GetAttribute("OrbitBoundsSize"),v:GetAttribute("OrbitBoundsCFrame")
	if boundsSize and boundsCF then
		local orientation=CFrame.lookAt(center+direction,center).Rotation
		local pixels=v.AbsoluteSize
		local aspect=if pixels.X>0 and pixels.Y>0 then pixels.X/pixels.Y else v.Size.X.Offset/math.max(v.Size.Y.Offset,1)
		local tanV=math.tan(math.rad(v.CurrentCamera.FieldOfView*.5))
		local tanH=tanV*math.max(aspect,.1)
		local half=boundsSize*.5
		distance=1
		for _,x in {-1,1} do for _,y in {-1,1} do for _,z in {-1,1} do
			local corner=boundsCF:VectorToWorldSpace(Vector3.new(half.X*x,half.Y*y,half.Z*z))
			local q=orientation:VectorToObjectSpace(corner)
			distance=math.max(distance,q.Z+math.abs(q.X)/tanH,q.Z+math.abs(q.Y)/tanV)
		end end end
		distance*=1.15
	end
	v.CurrentCamera.CFrame=CFrame.lookAt(center+direction*distance,center)
end
local function show(v,model,actor,yaw,pitch)
	v.PreviewWorld:ClearAllChildren()
	if not model then return end
	local n=0
	for _,p in model:GetDescendants() do
		if p:IsA("BasePart") then p.Anchored=true;p.CanCollide=false;n+=1
		elseif p:IsA("Trail") or p:IsA("ParticleEmitter") then p.Enabled=false end
	end
	if n==0 then model:Destroy();return end
	model.Parent=v.PreviewWorld
	local cf,size=model:GetBoundingBox()
	local span=math.max(size.Y,size.X/(v.Size.X.Offset/v.Size.Y.Offset),size.Z*.8,1)
	local distance=span/(2*math.tan(math.rad(16)))*1.18
	v:SetAttribute("OrbitCenter",cf.Position);v:SetAttribute("OrbitDistance",distance)
	if v:GetAttribute("FitBoundsOnOrbit") then v:SetAttribute("OrbitBoundsSize",size);v:SetAttribute("OrbitBoundsCFrame",cf) end
	orbit(v,yaw or 18,pitch or 5)
end
local function cleanClone(source)
	local archivable=source.Archivable;source.Archivable=true
	local clone=source:Clone();source.Archivable=archivable
	if not clone then return nil end
	for _,v in clone:GetDescendants() do
		if v:IsA("LuaSourceContainer") or v:IsA("JointInstance") or v:IsA("Animator") then v:Destroy()
		elseif v:IsA("BasePart") then v.Anchored=true
		elseif v:IsA("Trail") or v:IsA("ParticleEmitter") then v:Destroy() end
	end
	for _,name in {"EquipmentArmor","TrainingArmor","TrainingWeapon","WeaponR","WeaponL"} do
		local old=clone:FindFirstChild(name);if old then old:Destroy() end
	end
	clone:PivotTo(CFrame.new())
	return clone
end
local function addWeapon(actor,target,id)
	local model=Builder.build(id);model.Name="PreviewWeapon"
	local root=actor.PrimaryPart or actor:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart") or actor:FindFirstChild("Root")
	if not root then model:Destroy();return end
	local sizes={Hammer=.7,SwordShield=.8,Katana=.75,Glaive=.55,DualDaggers=.9,Bow=.7,GreatAxe=.7}
	for _,assembly in model:GetChildren() do
		local left=assembly.Name=="Offhand" or id=="Bow"
		local bone=if target=="Pet" then actor:FindFirstChild(if left then "GripL" else "GripR")
			else actor:FindFirstChild(if left then "LeftHand" else "RightHand") or actor:FindFirstChild(if left then "Left Arm" else "Right Arm")
		if bone then
			assembly:ScaleTo(if target=="Pet" then sizes[id] else .9)
			local position=bone.Position+(if target=="Pet" then Vector3.zero else Vector3.new(0,-bone.Size.Y*.35,0))
			assembly:PivotTo(CFrame.new(position)*root.CFrame.Rotation*CFrame.Angles(-.25,if id=="Bow" then math.pi/2 else 0,0))
		end
	end
	model.Parent=actor
end

-- Server-owned economy. Account storage commits before acknowledging mutations.
local HttpService = game:GetService("HttpService")
local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")
local Economy = require(script.Parent.HuntEconomyRules)
local Preview = require(script.Parent.SpecimenPreviewModel)
local BioTubes = require(script.Parent.BioTubeService)
local AdminRedeem = require(script.Parent.AdminRedeemPolicy)
local Service = {}
Service.__index = Service
local activeService
-- Studio inspection and other server systems can observe the running service.
function Service.current() return activeService end
local NAMES = {Skin="da", Tooth="răng", Scale="vảy", Bone="xương", Iron="sắt"}
local ERRORS = {InsufficientCoins="Không đủ xu.", InsufficientMaterials="Không đủ nguyên liệu.",
	InsufficientItems="Không đủ vật dụng.", MaximumLevel="Vũ khí này đã đạt cấp 2.", InvalidWeapon="Vũ khí không hợp lệ.", ActiveRun="Hãy kết thúc lượt săn trước."}
local function actor(s)
	return s and s.Character and s.Character.Parent and s.Root and s.Root.Parent and s.Humanoid and s.Humanoid.Health > 0
end
local function set(p, name, value) if p.Parent and p:GetAttribute(name) ~= value then p:SetAttribute(name, value) end end
function Service.new(options)
	local self = setmetatable({Profiles={}, Offers={}, LastRequest={}, LastCodeRequest={}, Connections={}, Random=Random.new(), Stations={}}, Service)
	for key, value in options do self[key] = value end
	self.Remote = Instance.new("RemoteEvent"); self.Remote.Name="HunDinoEconomyAction"; self.Remote.Parent=ReplicatedStorage
	table.insert(self.Connections, self.Remote.OnServerEvent:Connect(function(p, action, token) self:Request(p, action, token) end))
	self:_stations()
	local visuals=Instance.new("Folder");visuals.Name="SpecimenVisuals"
	local template=Preview.build(workspace:WaitForChild("Dinosaur01_TRex_Visual"))
	template.Parent=visuals;visuals.Parent=ReplicatedStorage;self.Visuals=visuals
	self.BioTubes=BioTubes.new(self,template)
	activeService=self
	return self
end
function Service:Profile(player)
 if self.Persistence then
  local data=self.Persistence:Data(player)
  return data and data.Economy
 end
	local profile=self.Profiles[player.UserId]
	if not profile then profile=Economy.new(); self.Profiles[player.UserId]=profile end
	return profile
end
function Service:Register(player)
 if not self:Profile(player) then return false end
 self:Publish(player);return true
end
function Service:IsReady(player)
 return not self.Persistence or self.Persistence:CanMutate(player)
end
function Service:_apply(player,request)
 if not self.Persistence then return Economy.apply(self:Profile(player),request) end
 return self.Persistence:CommitEconomy(player,function(profile,statistics)
  local abandoned=request.Op=="CloseRun" and profile.ActiveRun and profile.ActiveRun.State=="Hunting"
  local result=Economy.apply(profile,request)
  if result.Ok and not result.Replay and not result.Unchanged and request.Op=="Finish" then
   if request.Result=="Failed" then statistics.HuntsFailed+=1
   else statistics.HuntsCompleted+=1 end
   if request.Result=="Captured" then statistics.Captures+=1 end
  end
  if abandoned and result.Ok and not result.Replay then statistics.HuntsFailed+=1 end
  return result
 end)
end
function Service:_notice(player, message)
	set(player,"HuntLootText",message)
	if player.Parent then self.Remote:FireClient(player,"Notice",message); if self.Message then self.Message(player,message) end end
end
function Service:Publish(player, notice, openContext)
	local p=self:Profile(player); if not p or not player.Parent then return end
	set(player,"EconomyReady",true); set(player,"EconomyCoins",p.Coins); set(player,"HammerUpgradeLevel",p.HammerLevel)
	set(player,"HammerDamageMultiplier",Economy.damageMultiplier(p,"Hammer"))
 for _, weaponId in Economy.WeaponOrder do set(player,"WeaponLevel_"..weaponId,p.WeaponLevels[weaponId]) end
	local data=Economy.snapshot(p)
	if self.BioTubes then self.BioTubes:Sync(player,p) end
 data.StorageMode=if self.Persistence then self.Persistence.Mode else "ServerMemory"
 data.SaveState=player:GetAttribute("ProfileSaveState")
 data.CanBuy=self:_context(player,"Merchant")
 data.CanCraft=self:_context(player,"Craft")
	set(player,"SpecimenCount",data.SpecimenCount);set(player,"SpecimenLimit",data.SpecimenLimit)
	set(player,"SpecimenFull",data.SpecimenCount>=data.SpecimenLimit)
	for key,value in p.Materials do set(player,"Material"..key,value) end
	for key,value in p.StoredConsumables do set(player,"Stored"..key,value) end
	local offer=self.Offers[player]
	if openContext or not offer or offer.Revision~=p.Revision then
		offer={Context=openContext or (offer and offer.Context) or "Inventory",Revision=p.Revision,Token=HttpService:GenerateGUID(false)}
		self.Offers[player]=offer
	end
	local snapshot=data
	snapshot.Stored=snapshot.StoredConsumables; snapshot.OperationToken=offer.Token; snapshot.Context=offer.Context; snapshot.Notice=notice
	if snapshot.ActiveRun then snapshot.ActiveRun.IronTraps=snapshot.ActiveRun.Traps end
	self.Remote:FireClient(player,if openContext then "Open" else "Snapshot",snapshot)
end
function Service:_quiet(player)
	local s=self.GetState(player)
	return actor(s) and not s.Travelling and not s.Drawn and s.ChangeDraw==nil and not s.Charge and not s.Blocking
		and not s.Sprinting and os.clock()>=s.BusyUntil and player:GetAttribute("AdminFlying")~=true
end
function Service:_context(player, context)
	if not self:_quiet(player) then return false end
	local s=self.GetState(player)
	if s.InHunting or s.InTraining or self:Profile(player).ActiveRun then return false end
	local station
	if context=="Merchant" then station=self.Stations.Merchant
	elseif context=="Craft" then station=self.Stations[player:GetAttribute("BaseId")] end
	return station~=nil and (s.Root.Position-station.Position).Magnitude<=13
end
function Service:Open(player, context)
	if context~="Inventory" and context~="Shop" and not self:_context(player,context) then
		self:_notice(player,if context=="Craft" then "Đến bàn chế tạo tại base của bạn, cất vũ khí và dừng động tác." else "Đến quầy tiếp tế ở sảnh, cất vũ khí và dừng động tác."); return false
	end
	if (context=="Inventory" or context=="Shop") and not actor(self.GetState(player)) then return false end
	local quest=self.GetQuest(); if quest then quest:CancelAction(player,"Menu") end
	self:Publish(player,nil,context); return true
end
function Service:RedeemCode(player, rawCode)
	local function reply(ok, code, message)
		if player.Parent then self.Remote:FireClient(player,"CodeResult",{Ok=ok,Code=code,Message=message}) end
	end
	local now = os.clock()
	if now - (self.LastCodeRequest[player] or -math.huge) < 1 then
		reply(false,"RateLimited","Hãy chờ một giây rồi nhập lại.");return
	end
	self.LastCodeRequest[player] = now
	local request, failure = AdminRedeem.Resolve(player.UserId, rawCode)
	if not request then
		reply(false,failure,if failure=="NotEligible" then "Mã này chỉ dành cho tài khoản admin thử nghiệm." else "Mã không hợp lệ. Kiểm tra lại code đã nhập.");return
	end
	-- Refuse memory-only fallback: a one-time account grant needs durable storage.
	if not self.Persistence or not self:IsReady(player) or not self:Profile(player) then
		reply(false,"SavePending","Hồ sơ chưa sẵn sàng để lưu. Hãy chờ hoặc thử tải/lưu lại tiến trình.");return
	end
	request.RedeemedAt = os.time()
	local receipt = self:_apply(player, request)
	if receipt.Ok then
		local destination=if self.Persistence.Mode=="LocalFile" then "trên máy" else "vào tài khoản"
		local message = "Đã nhận 500 xu và 10 mỗi loại: da, răng, vảy, xương, sắt. Đã lưu "..destination.."."
		self:Publish(player,message);reply(true,"CodeRedeemed",message)
	else
		local messages = {AlreadyRedeemed="Bạn đã sử dụng mã này; mỗi mã chỉ nhận được một lần.",
			Capacity="Kho đã đạt giới hạn, chưa nhận thưởng và mã chưa được sử dụng.",
			SavePending="Đang chờ xác nhận lưu. Hãy dùng trạng thái lưu để thử lại, rồi kiểm tra kho trước khi nhập lại."}
		reply(false,receipt.Code,messages[receipt.Code] or "Chưa nhận được thưởng. Hãy thử lại khi hồ sơ sẵn sàng.")
	end
end
function Service:Request(player, action, token)
	if type(action)~="string" or #action>40 then return end
	if action=="RedeemCode" then self:RedeemCode(player,token);return end
 if not self:Profile(player) then return end
 if action=="RefreshShop" then
  self.LastShopRefresh=self.LastShopRefresh or {}
  local now=os.clock()
  if now-(self.LastShopRefresh[player] or -math.huge)<.5 then return end
  self.LastShopRefresh[player]=now
  if actor(self.GetState(player)) then self:Publish(player) end
  return
 end
	local time=os.clock(); if time-(self.LastRequest[player] or -math.huge)<.12 and action~="CarveCancel" then return end
	self.LastRequest[player]=time
	if action=="OpenShop" then self:Open(player,"Shop");return end
 if action=="GetInventory" then
		if actor(self.GetState(player)) then
			local quest=self.GetQuest();if quest then quest:CancelAction(player,"Menu") end
			self:Publish(player)
		end
		return
	end
	if action=="SetDisplaySlot" then
		local payload=token
		if type(payload)~="table" or not self:IsReady(player) then return end
		local profile=self:Profile(player);local offer=self.Offers[player]
		if not offer or type(payload.OperationToken)~="string" or payload.OperationToken~=offer.Token
			or offer.Revision~=profile.Revision or payload.OperationSerial~=profile.OperationSerial+1 then
			self:Publish(player,"Kho vừa cập nhật; hãy chọn lại cá thể.");return
		end
		if not self.BioTubes:CanUse(player,payload.Slot) then
			self:_notice(player,"Đến gần ống nghiệm đích tại base của bạn và cất vũ khí bằng R.");return
		end
		local receipt=self:_apply(player,{Op="SetDisplaySlot",Slot=payload.Slot,SpecimenId=payload.SpecimenId,
			OperationSerial=profile.OperationSerial+1})
		local text=if receipt.Ok then (if payload.SpecimenId then "Đã đặt cá thể vào ống #"..payload.Slot..". Cá thể vẫn được giữ trong kho."
			else "Đã tháo cá thể khỏi ống #"..payload.Slot.."; cá thể vẫn ở trong kho.")
			else "Chưa thể thay đổi ống nghiệm: "..tostring(receipt.Code)
		self:Publish(player,text);self:_notice(player,text);return
	end
	if action=="CarveStart" or action=="CarveCancel" then

 if not self:IsReady(player) then return false,"Tiến trình chưa tải/lưu xong. Hãy chờ trạng thái lưu sẵn sàng." end
	local p=self:Profile(player)
	if p.ActiveRun then return false,"Lượt trước chưa trả xong vật dụng." end
	run.EconomySerial=p.RunSerial+1
	run.SpecimenId=HttpService:GenerateGUID(false)
	local receipt=self:_runRequest(player,run,"OpenRun",{MonsterId=run.MonsterId})
	if not receipt.Ok then return false,"Chưa chuẩn bị được kho cho lượt săn." end
	run.Traps=p.ActiveRun.Traps; run.Potions=p.ActiveRun.Potions
	set(player,"QuestRewardText",""); return true
end
function Service:Start(player,run)
	local receipt=self:_runRequest(player,run,"StartRun")
	if receipt.Ok then run.EconomyStarted=true end
	return receipt.Ok
end
function Service:Sync(player,run)
	local p=self:Profile(player); if not p then return false end; local active=p.ActiveRun
	if not run.EconomyStarted or not active or active.State~="Hunting" then return true end
	if active.Traps==run.Traps and active.Potions==run.Potions then return true end
	return self:_runRequest(player,run,"SyncItems",{Traps=run.Traps,Potions=run.Potions}).Ok
end
function Service:Result(player,run)
	if not run.EconomyStarted then return true end
	local extra={Result=run.Result,Traps=run.Traps,Potions=run.Potions}
	if run.Result=="Captured" then
		if not run.SpecimenRecord then
			run.SpecimenRecord={Id=run.SpecimenId,SpeciesId="TRex",Name="T-Rex",Variant="Normal",Element="None",
				SizeScale=1,CapturedAt=DateTime.now().UnixTimestamp,SourceRunId=run.Id,SourceMonsterId=run.MonsterId}
		end
		extra.Specimen=run.SpecimenRecord
		if not run.EconomyCaptureRolls then
			run.EconomyCaptureRolls={}; for i=1,3 do run.EconomyCaptureRolls[i]={TypeRoll=self.Random:NextNumber(),QuantityRoll=self.Random:NextNumber()} end
		end
		extra.Rolls=run.EconomyCaptureRolls
	end
	local receipt=self:_runRequest(player,run,"Finish",extra)
	if receipt.Ok then
		local text=if run.Result=="Captured" then "Đã thêm T-Rex vào Inventory → Khủng long, cùng nguyên liệu, 1 xương và 40 xu." elseif run.Result=="Defeated" then "Đã nhận 1 xương và 40 xu. Đến xác giữ G để mổ tối đa 3 lượt." else "Đã giữ đồ nhặt; nhiệm vụ thất bại không có gói thưởng."
		set(player,"QuestRewardText",text); self:_notice(player,text)
	end
	return receipt.Ok
end
function Service:CanCapture(player,run)
 if not self:IsReady(player) then return false,"ItemsBlocked" end
	return Economy.canCapture(self:Profile(player),run.Id,run.EconomySerial)
end
function Service:Close(player,run)
	return self:_runRequest(player,run,"CloseRun",{Traps=run.Traps,Potions=run.Potions,EntryFailed=not run.EconomyStarted}).Ok
end
function Service:Grant(player,run,kind,sourceId,index)
	if kind=="Ore" and sourceId~=run.Id..":Ore:"..tostring(index) then return false end
	if kind=="Drop" and sourceId~=run.MonsterId..":ScaleDrop" then return false end
	if kind=="Carve" and sourceId~=run.MonsterId then return false end
	local extra={Index=index}
	if kind=="Carve" then
		run.EconomyCarveRolls=run.EconomyCarveRolls or {}
		run.EconomyCarveRolls[index]=run.EconomyCarveRolls[index] or self.Random:NextNumber()
		extra.TypeRoll=run.EconomyCarveRolls[index]
	end
	local before=table.clone(self:Profile(player).Materials)
	local receipt=self:_runRequest(player,run,kind,extra)
	if receipt.Ok then
		local gained={}; for key,value in self:Profile(player).Materials do local count=value-before[key]; if count>0 then table.insert(gained,tostring(count).." "..NAMES[key]) end end
		self:_notice(player,if #gained>0 then "Đã nhận "..table.concat(gained,", ").." vào kho thử." else "Nguồn này đã được ghi nhận trước đó.")
	end
	return receipt.Ok,receipt
end
function Service:DamageMultiplier(player)
 local profile=self:Profile(player);return if profile then Economy.damageMultiplier(profile) else 1
end
function Service:RemovePlayer(player)
	if self.BioTubes then self.BioTubes:Clear(player) end
	self.Offers[player]=nil; self.LastRequest[player]=nil
	self.LastCodeRequest[player]=nil
end
